description: This file defines a React functional component 'IntegrationCard' that displays information about an integration, including its status, connected services, configuration, and provides action buttons for editing, deleting, and toggling the activation state.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns a color class based on the integration's status.

methods.name: getStatusIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon (emoji) representing the current status of the integration.

methods.name: getConnectorIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon representing the connector service based on its ID.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date string into a human-readable date in 'en-US' locale.
